parameters.name: Bucket
parameters.description: The bucket of the data cache. The default value is default.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token. You can use the client to generate a token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: DataSource
parameters.description: The information about the data source.

parameters.name: EipCreateParam
parameters.description:
Creates and attaches an EIP.
If no NAT gateway is configured for the VPC, you can attach an EIP to the data cache to pull data from the Internet.

parameters.name: EipInstanceId
parameters.description: The elastic IP address (EIP). If no NAT gateway is configured for the virtual private cloud (VPC), you can attach an EIP to the data cache to pull data from the Internet.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the data cache.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: RetentionDays
parameters.description: The number of days to retain the data cache. The data cache is cleared after it expires. By default, the data cache does not expire.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: The size of the data cache.
